section.p: Each command takes the docs root, the folder that holds opend.config.yaml, as its argument. It defaults to the current folder. Run pnpm opend help <command> for the same information.

refsyn.title: opend validate [dir]
refsyn.p: Runs every check and prints the problems. Exits with status 1 on any error, or on any problem with --strict.

strow.stentry: working tree
Validate a git branch or tag instead of the files on disk.
off
Treat warnings as failures.

text prints file:line:column: severity [code] message and a summary. json prints the problems as a JSON array. github prints GitHub Actions workflow annotations, so problems show inline on pull requests.

refsyn.title: opend build [dir]
refsyn.p: Compiles the docs into the release snapshot the hosted build stores: JSON holding every topic with its conditions, the navigation, publications, context-sensitive help keys and the reuse index. Fails without writing anything when there is an error.

strow.stentry: working tree
Build a git branch or tag.
Where to write the snapshot. The default is inside the docs root.

refsyn.title: opend preview [dir]
refsyn.p: Serves the docs locally and rebuilds on save. See .

strow.stentry: Preview as a named reader from preview-contexts.yaml. An unknown name is an error that lists the known ones.
